changes: When the café is closed, the customer page now tells you when it next opens — the time, whether that is later today, tomorrow or the coming Sunday, and how long the wait is. It used to always say "See you next Sunday!" and "Opens 10:15 AM & 12:45 PM", so someone arriving at 09:50 on a Sunday, 25 minutes before opening, was sent away for a week. The page now refreshes itself every minute and goes straight to the menu the moment the café opens.

If the café is scheduled to be serving but the counter has not opened yet, the page now says "Closed right now" and gives the time it is meant to be open until — instead of pointing the customer at the next session hours away. Someone standing there at 10:20, while the counter was five minutes late opening, used to be told the café opens at 12:45.

Opening times are now editable under Admin > Settings > Opening Times: which days the café serves, and up to four sessions each with its own name, opening time and closing time. The customer page follows whatever is set there, so changing a service time no longer needs a code change.
The app has a new look. The background is now clean white instead of cream, and all text is darker and sharper — easier to read on the counter iPad and on a phone in daylight.

On the POS, the order states are much easier to tell apart at a glance. Pre-orders and preparing orders used to look almost the same colour to some people; they no longer do, and every state now also says what it is in words.
When a receipt has been sent, the order card is outlined and labelled "RECEIPT SENT — check it", so it no longer relies on colour alone.
Text boxes throughout the app now have a visible border, and the faint grey hint text inside them is readable.

Your order total and the Place Order button now stay visible at the bottom of the cart — only the list of drinks scrolls. With a few drinks in the basket the total and the button used to sit off the bottom of the screen on a phone and on the tablet, so there was nothing to tap

Every line in the cart now shows its price. Staff-link orders show the normal price struck through beside the RM 5.00 staff price, and a free ministry pre-order says FREE on each line and makes no claim about paying

Drink options now say what they are. Each row of choices is labelled — Temperature, Milk, Flavour — instead of unnamed rows of buttons, optional groups are marked optional, and on the menu the choices tuck behind a Change link so more drinks fit on screen

An expired or finished order link now says "This order has closed" with a link back to the menu, instead of sitting on "Loading order…" and "Connection error, retrying…" for ever. A genuine connection problem still says so, and still keeps retrying

Notifications now ask at the moment you tap "Yes, notify me", not silently when the page opens — and if setting them up fails the page tells you instead of leaving you expecting an alert that never comes
Sold-out drinks are now readable. The whole card was faded to near-invisible; the Sold out badge, the name and the price are all now clearly legible
The tracking page now leads with how long your drink will be — "Ready in about 6 min", with your place in the queue underneath
Paying is now spelled out clearly: scan the DuitNow QR printed on your table.
Two equally easy ways to tell the cashier you've paid — upload the payment screenshot, or show your payment at the counter.
Ministry pre-orders no longer ask you to pay: a free pre-order now says "Free — nothing to pay".

POS order board: the queue is now ordered by who has waited longest, so the most urgent order sits at the top of its lane. Orders with a receipt come first, then oldest first — the same order in every lane and in the list view. Previously the Pending lane put the newest order first, so an order that had already waited 17 minutes could render sixth, well below the fold

POS order board: if the tablet loses its connection the board now says so. The badge at the top changes to LAST SEEN OPEN with the time, a message explains how old the figures are and offers Retry, and the buttons that change orders are switched off until it reconnects. Previously a dropped connection showed an empty board under a green OPEN badge, which looked exactly like having no orders

Opening checklist: now shows how many items are done out of the total with a progress bar, says when there are more items below, and the Open Café button names how many are still outstanding. Tapping it while items remain scrolls to the first unticked one and highlights it, instead of doing nothing. All 12 items are reachable — four used to be hidden below the fold, including Enable menu items & food quantities in POS

Admin > Menu: on the menu and serving today are now two clearly named switches on every row, each with the reason shown beside it, and the summary line and filters no longer mix them up. The bulk buttons ask for confirmation and then tell you what they changed — Disable All used to change serving today while every badge and count showed the permanent menu setting, so it could look like nothing had happened. Delete is now quieter and asks for the item by name

Admin: a warning before you lose unsaved edits. Leaving a page or switching tabs with unsaved Checklist or Settings changes now asks first and says how many changes are at stake — previously they were discarded silently. Undoing your own edits puts the warning back to sleep

Easier to read and to tap: lane headings, wait times and switched-off menu rows are far clearer in bright light at the counter, every button and switch is now at least 44px including the small Admin toggles, and all 14 Admin sidebar destinations — Logout included — are reachable on the counter tablet without hunting

Special requests can now be added to each drink separately. Ordering three lattes and want less sugar in just one? Type it on that one. Each drink you add is now its own line on the order with its own note box, and the note shows on the POS card, the order details and the barista's prep screen. The whole-order box is still there for anything that applies to everything

Ministry pre-orders: the person who placed the order can now change their collection time when they edit it, choosing from the times offered on their pre-order link — previously only the items could be changed

Security hardening across the POS, the barista prep screen and Admin: names, drink names and special requests typed by customers or volunteers are now always treated as plain text when displayed, so unusual characters (quotes, angle brackets) can no longer disturb the page

Fix: customer notifications work again. When someone taps "Yes, notify me" on the tracking page and allows notifications, their phone is now alerted when their order is confirmed and when it is ready — until now they were being asked for permission and then never receiving anything

Admin Dashboard redesigned: a compact Right now strip at the top (pending, preparing and the longest wait) when you are looking at today, then the day's figures led by revenue. Zero-order days no longer show four empty panels, and the Latest Stock Count is tucked away until you open it
Admin Dashboard: three new charts — where orders came from, the top items sold, and the two services side by side (orders and revenue shown separately, so neither is squeezed to fit the other)
Admin Dashboard: new order source breakdown showing how many orders were walk-ins at the counter, ministry pre-orders, or placed by customers on their phones
Admin Dashboard: headings now name the day you are viewing, so an earlier Sunday no longer says Today's Discounts

Fix: the Sunday end-of-day revenue email will arrive again. It stopped being sent on 16 August — closing the café now hands the summary to the scheduled job instead of trying to send it as the café-close screen finishes, which could be cut short

Fix: the end-of-day email is dated correctly. It had been headed with the Saturday before the service (Saturday, 1 August for the 2 August Sunday) because the date was worked out in UTC rather than Malaysian time

Staff link: staff can now order from their own phone at the staff price — drinks at RM5, food at the normal price. Set up the link under Admin > Staff Link. The cashier is asked to confirm the staff price before approving, so nothing is discounted without a volunteer agreeing to it

Ministry pre-orders can now be changed by the person who placed them — add a drink, change an item or cancel, right up until the counter releases the order to the barista. No need to delete the order in the POS and ask them to order again
